page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core, providing predictable compute performance. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

For local storage, the r9gd.8xlarge includes 1900 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, offering high-speed, low-latency local data access. The server operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps. It does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space or caching layers. It is highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caches, real-time analytics, and data processing pipelines where ARM64 architecture compatibility is met.
